notes: USB 3 (XHCI) controllers work natively. Map ports after install with USBToolBox (macOS 11.3+ limits each controller to 15 ports without a map).
USB (UVC) webcams normally work without drivers once their USB port is in the USB map. MIPI/IPU cameras (some 12th-gen+ laptops) do not.
Fingerprint readers and Windows Hello IR cameras never work in macOS (Touch ID needs Apple's Secure Enclave). Disable in BIOS if possible and leave out of the USB map.
No official driver for PCIe Realtek/O2 readers (USB-attached readers usually work). Community drivers exist but are not added automatically.
Thunderbolt hot-plug generally does not work; USB-C data/charging usually does. Devices connected at boot may work.
